text: Well done, <name>! With all three samples in hand, I'll brew ye a vial o' water so pure it'd make the mountains weep. It's the final piece for yer rite o' passage. I'm proud to call ye kin, <name>. Ye've done <class> proud, and I look forward to hearing yer tales in the future.
Call of Water

Norric will have one more task for ye before rewarding ye with the water totem rites. The vial of water I've given ye is necessary for whatever that task is. Go now and find him. We shall meet again some day.
Bring the Vial of Purest Water to Norric Lochthane in Loch Modan.

Hello again, <name>. Yer looking well. 

What brings you back to me so soon?

Ahh, water blessed by Hervdana herself, and gathered by your own hands? A gift indeed. 

These vials shall birth your sapta, letting you glimpse the water spirits at Stendel's Pond, near Moonbrook. The last few drops of the water have an equally important purpose... waste not even a cork stopper dampened with sacred water.
Call of Water

In Westfall, outside o' Moonbrook lies Stendel's Pond. Once a pure spring, now touched by dark forces. The spirits there 'ave gone silent. 

Ye must drink the water sapta, then face the corruption that fouls the waters. Take its bracers and the last drops o' Hervdana's potion, then place 'em on the shrine. That'll call forth a spirit, cleansed and true. Speak with it, learn what ye can.

Bring me proof the deed's done, and I'll grant ye the totem.

Drink the Water Sapta and Cleanse the corruption at Stendel's Pond in Westfall.
Return to Norric in Loch Modan when finished.

The shrine stands aged and forgotten, cloaked in dust and cobwebs. The pond beside it lies eerily still, its surface untouched by wind or life. Scattered along the shore are the bones of beasts once burdened by labor. The water's murky sheen raises a troubling question--has it been poisoned by the surrounding malaise, or is it the very source of it?

You place the bracers atop the shrine and then pour the remaining drops of Norric's potion into dry stone. You begin to incant the simple words Norric taught you and the droplets vaporize atop the stone within the bindings....
Call of Water

Light erupts as the final word leaves your lips. The hiss of water turning to mist fades into silence, and your senses reel as the corrupt spirits around you unravel, their essence scattered like ash in the wind.
Speak to the Minor Manifestation of Water in Westfall.

Thanks to you. Thanks to the shamans.

Corruption ebbs but life continues to wane. Up to shamans to protect life.
Call of Water

Take shard. Take shard and give life.

Give life and understand. Understand water is life... corruption stops life.

You protect and give life with water's power.
Bring the Shard of Water to Norric Lochthane in Loch Modan.
How fared your journey to Westfall? Success there is hard to measure, but even small victories carry weight.

Aye, this is the proof I asked for, and ye've done well, <name>. I'm proud to be the first to offer my congratulations--and yer water totem. Use it wisely, and may fortune walk beside ye.

Yer next trial won't come soon, so take this time to learn. Pure water heals, aye, but its gifts go far beyond mending wounds.
Water Sapta
I'm sorry to see you need another Sapta, but you've earned it.
Take the water sapta and find the tainted pond water in Westfall, <name>. I have great faith in your abilities.
